# Afshal Amir — Portfolio

> Muhammad Afshal Amir (Afshal Amir) is a Lahore-based Digital Marketing & Brand Growth Manager, AI-driven marketing strategist and software engineer, and the Marketing Director of Star X Marketing (https://www.starxmarketing.com). He builds brands, websites, content, paid campaigns and AI automations for businesses in Pakistan, the UK and Canada.

## Services
- Branding and graphic design; logo and identity systems
- Social media marketing and content creation (reels, carousels, campaigns)
- Website and e-commerce development (WordPress, Elementor, WooCommerce, Shopify)
- SEO and GEO (generative engine optimisation)
- Paid advertising (Meta, Google, TikTok)
- Influencer marketing
- AI automation: chatbots, AI support agents, CRM, WhatsApp and email workflows

## Selected work
- Jolta Electric — EV maker, Pakistan: website UI, dealership signage, billboards; Best Performance Award (Nov 2025)
- Gaming Wala Bhai — gaming brand identity and website
- Lawyers Connect — Glasgow solicitors: identity, website, social content
- ARTOSO Construction & Renovation — Ontario contractor website
